author: Bobby Grayson
description: Bank (per-actor), Lock (cross-actor + FCFS), Supervisor (links/exits), Task (monitors). Recurring pitfalls: apply with hypotheses about the source forces the target to unify with it; use bullets.
title: Four examples now translate from Elixir and each has an invariant proof with the same recipe: bounded check, then frame lemma + termination lemma + one example-specific shape. Per-example proof cost is now ~300 lines and mostly cases that are one 'apply'
